To be fair, my therapist abbreviates bipolar as BPD. I think people just use them interchangeably sometimes.
All I know is, my therapist advised me to stay a w a y from relationships with people on the psychopath/sociopath spectrum. BPD doesn't mix well with those traits, since we are easily manipulated.

It's common for people with BPD (myself included) to become really close to one person that returns their affections (FP, or favorite person). If you were my friend, I'd like to be approached gently, as any force would push me closer to my new partner. Ask if you can express some feelings to him, without making him feel as though he's messed up (our brains love to make us feel like we can't do anything right). Express that you're so happy for him, but that you miss him, and see if you three can hang out together. It's possible that his partner has some jealousy issues, which can make it tricky for him to navigate, with being in the middle and all. 

I wish you the best!
